title: tsurara plugin and external backend protocol
description: `describe` answers with Describe; `generate` receives GenerateRequest and answers with GenerateResponse; the extend hook receives ExtendInput and answers with Files; transformFiles receives and answers with Files; transformModel receives and answers with the model (sem-model.schema.json). Plugin modules exchange SessionRequest and SessionResponse, one per line.

semVersions.description: The model versions (`semVersion`) the program accepts.

lowering.description:
The shared lowering the program wants: `generate` then receives `lowered`, the
model lowered to `tir` for these capabilities. Optional, in protocols 1 and 2.

naming.description:
The program's naming policy as data (needs `lowering`): `generate` then receives
`names`, allocated for `lowered` with this policy.

generated.description:
The first line of every generated file, in the language's comment syntax. The CLI deletes stale
files that start with it and leaves other files alone.

version.description: Where generated code records the runtime library version range it requires.

sidecars.description:
Extensions of files that tools keep next to generated files (`.uid` for Godot). They are deleted
together with a stale generated file.

Markers.description: How the CLI recognizes a backend's files (design.md 18.8).

file.description: Output file that holds the line, relative to the output root.

prefix.description: Prefix of the line; the rest of the line is the range.

capabilities.description: The constructs the program's language has (`tsurara_lower::Capabilities`).

Lowering.description: What a program asks of the shared lowering.

strictDecoding.description:
Whether decoding fails on an enum or discriminator value the definition does not list, so that
received values need a fallback (pass 5).

oneOf.description: String- and integer-valued enums.

DataPolicy.description:
A naming policy as data: rules per context (`type`, `function`, `member`, `parameter`,
`constant`, `file`; a missing context uses `type`'s rules), and initialisms written in capitals
by the Pascal and camel cases (`ID`, `URL`; `IDs` for the plural).

digitPrefix.description: Prefix of a name that would start with a digit (`V` in Go, `_` in many languages).

upperPrefix.description:
Prefix of a name that does not start with an upper-case letter after casing (Go's `X`, so
that every name is exported). Empty: none.

fallback.description: The name of a preferred name with no word in it.

ascii.description: Characters outside ASCII become `u` and their code point in hex (`u65e5`), for file names.

reserved.description: Words reserved in this context: keywords, globals, members the language defines.

oneOf.description: `PetStore`
`petStore`
`pet_store`
`PET_STORE`
`pet-store`
The preferred name with invalid characters replaced by `_`.

lowered.description: The model lowered for the capabilities of `describe`'s `lowering`; absent without it.

names.description: The names allocated for `lowered` with `describe`'s `naming`; absent without it.

schemas.description: Named types, in the order of components, followed by the hoisted types.

channels.description: The channels of `x-event-channels`, in document order.

names.description: Name requests, in the order backends must claim them (design.md 18.4.6).

preferredName.description:
The name the definition asks for, before any language's rules (the components key, a title,
or a derived name). `Writable` declarations share it with the declaration they split from.

name.description: The identifier a backend assigned. Empty in the model; backends fill it in their own copy.

NameId.description: Identifies a requested name. References in the model (`Type::Named`) point to it.

oneOf.description:
An integer, number or string from a schema, with its `format`. Backends lower it to their
own types; TypeScript prints `number` or `string` (design.md 18.4.1).

A schema mapped to an external type per language (`x-tsurara-type`, `typeMappings`,
`overrides`). A backend without an entry uses `schema` (design.md 18.4.4).

An inline object, enum or union, with what a backend needs to name it if it hoists it
(design.md 18.4.2). TypeScript writes it inline.

A raw byte value: a multipart part value or an HTTP body that is not JSON (design.md 6.4).
TypeScript lowers it to `Blob | File`.
`enum` with literal values. TypeScript lowers it to a union of literals (design.md 18.4.1).

Reference to a named type by its final identifier. Only backends produce it, when they resolve
`Named`.
Reference to a declaration by its name request (design.md 18.4.2).

`oneOf` or `anyOf` as written: members are not flattened or deduplicated, because that is not
exact for `oneOf` (design.md 18.4.1). TypeScript lowers it to a union.

The values a discriminator property takes in a schema that inherits the discriminator from its
parent through `allOf`. TypeScript lowers it to `{ property: 'value' }`.
A type defined outside the generator. Used by `x-tsurara-type` and `typeMappings`.

schema.description: The type the schema has without the mapping.

loc.description: Where the mapping is written, for warnings.

External.description: An external type. With `import`, files that use the type get an `import type`.

from.description: Module specifier. If it starts with `.`, it is relative to the output root.

pointer.description: Escaped JSON Pointer. The root is `""`.

Loc.description: A location in a definition. A pair of the document URL (without fragment) and a JSON Pointer.

preferredName.description: Derived from the owner's preferred name and the path to the schema (`PetOwner`).

loc.description: Where the schema is written. Its JSON Pointer is the key of `naming.overrides`.

values.description: The values in definition order, without duplicates and without `null`.

nullable.description: Whether `null` is one of the values.

hint.description: The preferred name, used only to order members deterministically inside the model.

required.description: Number of leading elements that are required. The rest of `items` are optional (`T?`).

rest.description: Type of the rest elements. `None` makes the length fixed.

values.description:
The values that select each member, in member order. Empty for a member that is not a
reference or has no value.

default.description: The `defaultMapping` target (3.2), when it is not one of the members.

index.description: Value type of the index signature `[key: string]: T`.

tags.description:
Tags with their values as written in the definition (`""` for tags without a value, such as
`deprecated`). Printers render them with `Doc::tag_text`.

Doc.description:
Documentation of a declaration or property: a description and tags such as `deprecated`,
`default`, `example`, `format` and constraints (design.md 18.4.5).

id.description: The `operationId`, or a name built from the method and path if absent.

nameId.description: The name request of the operation.

name.description: Name of the call function. Empty in the model; backends fill it in their own copy.

typeNames.description:
Type names derived from the operation, by template (`{P}Result` → `GetPetByIdResult`).
Empty in the model, like `name`; a backend fills in the names it assigned (design.md 6.6).

security.description:
Authentication alternatives in order: the operation's `security`, or the root's. Each lists
the schemes it needs together; an empty alternative means none. Empty without any `security`.

pagination.description: How a read is paginated (`x-tsurara-pagination`), for infinite queries.

contentType.description: Media type of a parameter given with `content`. The value is serialized in this format.

oneOf.description: `in: querystring` from 3.2. Represents the whole query string as one value.

events.description:
The events of a `text/event-stream` response whose media type has an item schema. The body
kind stays `stream`; a backend whose runtime reads events uses this instead (design.md 8.5).

items.description:
The items of a JSON Lines or JSON text sequence response whose media type has an item
schema. The body kind stays `stream`, as with `events` (design.md 8.5).

oneOf.description: Decided by the actual Content-Type (wildcard media types with a schema that is not binary).

BodyKind.description: How to parse a response body (design.md 8.5).

ty.description:
One event as a runtime hands it over: an object with `event`, `data`, `id` and `retry`, or a
union of such objects. `data` has the type of its `contentSchema` where it is JSON.

json.description: Which events carry JSON in `data`; `None` when none does.

Events.description: The events of a Server-Sent Events stream, from `itemSchema` (3.2) or `x-itemSchema`.

oneOf.description: Every event.
The events with these names.

ty.description: The type of one item, in the JSON context.

Items.description: The items of a sequential JSON response, from `itemSchema` (3.2) or `x-itemSchema`.

oneOf.description: One JSON text per line (`application/jsonl`, `application/x-ndjson`, ...).
JSON texts each starting with the record separator U+001E (`application/json-seq`, RFC 7464).

Framing.description: How the items of a sequential JSON body are separated.

oneOf.description: A range such as `2XX`. The value is the leading digit.

name.description: `apiKey`: the header, query or cookie name.

SecurityUse.description:
A security scheme an authentication alternative of an operation uses, with what a runtime needs
to place the credential (spec/operation-def.schema.json).

param.description:
The request field that carries the page: `query.cursor`, `header.X-Page`, `path.page` or
`cookie.page` (the parameter's `in`, then its name).

initial.description: The value of the first page; without it, the first request leaves the field out.

next.description:
JSON Pointer to the next page's value in a success body; absent or `null` there means no more
pages. Without it, the app says how to find the next page.

previous.description: JSON Pointer to the previous page's value, for queries read in both directions.

Pagination.description:
How a read is paginated: OpenAPI does not describe it, so it is written in
`x-tsurara-pagination` (or in a language's configuration).

ident.description: The identifier a backend assigned. Empty in the model; backends fill it in their own copy.

typeNames.description:
Type names derived from the channel, by template (`{P}Message`). Empty in the model, like
`ident`.

channel.description: The topic template (`board/{boardId}`), relative to the deployment's topic prefix.

parameters.description: The template's variables with their types, in the order of `parameters`.

private.description: Whether the hub requires a subscriber claim; informational.

contents.description: The message payload by media type, as a request or response body's content.

Channel.description:
An event channel of `x-event-channels`: messages such as the updates of a Mercure hub,
which are not the response of an operation.

language.description:
The backend that reported it (`typescript`), or `None` for warnings about the definition itself
(design.md 18.4.5).

oneOf.description:
A keyword the model cannot represent was dropped (`not`, `if`, `dependentSchemas`), or a value
cannot be what the definition says (`format: binary` inside JSON).
`$dynamicRef` was resolved statically per reference site.
A name was changed to avoid a collision.
A reference could not be resolved and became `unknown`.
The definition has an unexpected shape and was interpreted as far as possible.
A keyword written next to `$ref` was ignored (OpenAPI 3.0 ignores all siblings of `$ref`).

A wildcard media type (`*/*`, `application/*`) with a schema that is not binary. The body is
parsed by its actual Content-Type (`auto`) and sent as JSON (design.md 8.5).
A mapped type (`x-tsurara-type` and so on) has no entry for the language; the schema's type is used.

A required property refers back to its own declaration, so its sample value stops at a fixed
depth with `{}` (design.md 18.7.1).
A string with `pattern` and no `example`: its sample value may not match (design.md 18.7.1).

loc.description: Where the named thing is defined. Its JSON Pointer is the key of `naming.overrides`.

inRoot.description: Whether `loc` is in the root document (only names there can be overridden).

oneOf.description:
A schema declaration. `preserve`: the preferred name comes from the definition (a components
or `$defs` key) and is kept when it is a valid identifier.
The `Writable` variant of a schema (design.md 6.5).
An operation in `paths`.
A webhook, by its name.
An event channel of `x-event-channels`, by its name.

method.description: The method, when the callback has several operations; empty otherwise.

oneOf.description: An operation of a callback. Its name is derived from the operation that has the callback.

nameOverrides.description:
Preferred names per JSON Pointer (such as `#/components/schemas/Error`); each language's naming
rules still apply to them.

typeMappings.description: External types per `format`, then per language.

typeOverrides.description: External types per JSON Pointer, then per language.

externalImportBase.description:
Directory, relative to the output root, that relative `import.from` specifiers in `x-tsurara-type`
are written against (the directory of the configuration file). Empty means the output root.

wildcardAsJson.description: Treat wildcard media types (`*/*`, `application/*`) as JSON, for APIs that only return JSON.

operations.description:
Generate the operations of `paths` (OperationDefs, call functions and their types). Without
them the output holds the declarations, webhooks and channels, which need only the types layer
of the runtime.

runtime.description: Where generated code finds its runtime.

tags.description: Only operations with one of these tags or `operation_ids`; all when both are empty.

excludeTags.description:
Operations with one of these tags or `exclude_operation_ids` are left out, also when they
are included above.

Filter.description: Filter for the operations to generate. If everything is empty, all are generated.

oneOf.description: The package of the language's registry (`@tsurara/client`, `tsurara-client`, ...).

A copy of the runtime's sources written into the output, which generated code imports
instead of the package.

RuntimeSource.description: Where generated code finds its runtime library.

operations.description: The types of each operation of the model (`Model::operations`, in order).

Module.description: The lowered declarations of a model.

preferredName.description: The name the definition asks for; the backend's naming policy turns it into an identifier.

origin.description: Where the name comes from: a schema's name request, or a hoisted inline schema.

sites.description: Whether values of this declaration are sent, received, or both (design.md 18.5.3, pass 5).

oneOf.description: A declaration of the model; its name is claimed with this request.
An inline schema hoisted into a declaration (design.md 18.4.2).
Members decoded by trying them in order (with a runtime helper where the language needs one).

base.description: A base declaration, when the language has inheritance (pass 2).

additional.description:
Values of properties the record does not list (`additionalProperties`), as an extra map that
is flattened when serialized (pass 11).

boxed.description: The field needs indirection (`Box`), because the record contains itself through it (pass 10).

oneOf.description: Per language external types, and the type to use without an entry.

Site.description: How a reference uses a declaration: values going out, coming in, or both.

oneOf.description: Missing and `null` are different values; the language needs a wrapper to tell them apart (Q3).

Presence.description: Whether a field may be missing and whether it may be `null` (pass 8).

open.description:
Where values are received, unlisted values are kept in a fallback (pass 5). Where they are
sent, the enum is closed; references say which (`Expr::Named::site`).

oneOf.description: A native enum of the language.
Named constants of the base type, for languages without such enums.

open.description: Unlisted discriminator values are kept in a fallback where values are received (pass 6).

discriminator.description: The discriminator, when there is one but the language has no tagged unions.

body.description: Per request media type (`Body::contents`): `Bytes` for binary bodies. Sent.

responses.description:
Per response (`Operation::responses`) and media type: the value its body is read as (a string
for text, `Bytes` for binary). Received.

sequences.description:
Per response and media type: whether the body is read item by item, `responses` then
holding the type of one item (an event, or a JSON value) instead of the body's.

OperationTypes.description:
What an operation's call function takes and returns, lowered like declarations; inline schemas
in them are hoisted as candidates. Each list follows its model counterpart.

oneOf.description: Server-Sent Events: each item is an event object with `event`, `data`, `id` and `retry`.
One JSON value per line.
One JSON value per record starting with U+001E.

Sequence.description: A response body read item by item (design.md 8.5).

decls.description: One entry per declaration of `tir`, in order.

operations.description: One entry per operation of the model, in order.

AllocatedNames.description: The names of a lowered module, by position.

name.description: The type name (context `type`; one scope for all declarations).

file.description:
The file name without extension (context `file`, from the type name; one scope, where names
that differ only in case collide).

members.description:
Fields of a record (context `member`, from the wire names) or the values of an enum (context
`constant`), in order; each declaration is its own scope. Empty for other declarations.

function.description: The call function (context `function`, from the operation id; one scope, shared with no type).

manifest.description: Protocol 2: what the program generated, by name. Optional.

path.description: Path relative to the output root (`/`-separated).

types.description:
The declarations of the model (`Model::schemas`) the backend emitted, in model order.
Declarations the backend adds on its own (hoisted types) are not listed.

operations.description: The operations, then the webhooks, in model order.

file.description: Path of the file relative to the output root (`/`-separated), as in `OutputFile::path`.

TypeEntry.description: An identifier and the file that declares it.

function.description: The call function, if the backend emits one.

operationDef.description: The OperationDef value, if the backend emits one.

types.description:
Types derived from the operation, by role: `data`, `result`, `responses`, `errors`, `options`,
`event`, `item`, `request`, ... Each language lists the roles it has (docs/guide/plugins.md).

helpers.description:
Other values generated for the operation, by role: with TypeScript's
`query: tanstack`, `queryKey`, `queryOptions`, `queryFilter`, `setQueriesData` and
`getQueriesData` (reads), `infiniteQueryKey` and `infiniteQueryOptions` (paginated reads) and
`mutationOptions` (writes); with `mocks`, `mockHandler`.

file.description: Path of the file relative to the output root (`/`-separated), as in `OutputFile::path`.

Export.description: An identifier and the file that declares it.

model.description: The model the backend generated from (after model plugins).

manifest.description: What the backend generated, by name; `None` for external backends that return none.

marker.description: The first line every added file must start with (`Markers::generated`).
